original_card.question: Can a specified pair of consecutive calls eliminate a restoration that the next call reconstructs?
methods: Write typed entry/exit contracts and a contracting multitype recurrence.
Derive a lower bound for the compulsory transitions of one proposed typed interface.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Show actual eliminated work and legal composition; changing a scalar recurrence into a matrix is insufficient.

first_step.inspect: Find a concrete consecutive-call boundary in the selected review and list its entry/exit obligations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Specify two call types and one operation actually removed by composition; derive the normalized recurrence.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Eliminating compulsory boundary work can lower recursive cost beyond packing gains.
allowed_variations: A two-type pilot or one explicit deferred restoration.
scope_change_triggers: Rewriting the old scalar recurrence as a matrix without eliminating work.

actual_scope: Prove that omitted final helper climbs cannot pass the fixed physical FULL-frame R480 cleanup with canonical data and arbitrary source-independent helper boundary types. Include all batch lengths and recursion depths; classify the larger backward target-covariance class separately.
scope_change_reason: The original claim retains real source and target outputs. The proof now states the exact physical cleanup and adapter locations. Backward target covariance is a larger interface with genuine survivors, not part of the main no-saving theorem.
bottleneck_link: The selected complex moment binds. Deferral can improve its rank moment only if final helper climbs pass the real source and helper boundary. The theorem forces all 402 climbs in the declared class.
stop_rule: Complete the original boundary obstruction and the exact larger-interface classification. Do not claim that finite owner checks exclude multi-call encodings or changed native cleanup programs.
evidence: Written all-dimension proof; 402 inverse-source witnesses; both full 712-coordinate scalar maps; complete covariance classification by two exact methods; identical 3486 directional climb events; native pair frames, independent target projectors and one-tail owner cost theorem.
author: Ali Romman
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance with algebra, implementation, proof review, verification and writing.
